_comment: Octail's own egg (no upstream file; Pelican's BeamMP egg was not used). The official BeamMP-Server build for Debian 12 (x86_64) from the GitHub release (latest or a vX.Y.Z tag), its SHA-256 digest from the GitHub API checked, failures exit non-zero. ServerConfig.toml is edited line by line with the file parser before every start (BeamMP rewrites it in the same key = value form): port, AuthKey, name, description, map, players, cars per player, private flag, and the bind address 0.0.0.0. The AuthKey (keymaster.beammp.com) is the operator's: required, empty by default, never shipped. The start is BeamMP's ALL SYSTEMS STARTED line or the TCP port once bound; say is the broadcast; Ctrl+C stops it cleanly.
name: BeamMP Server
author: eggs@octail.net
description: BeamMP, the multiplayer mod for BeamNG.drive: the official BeamMP-Server for Linux. Needs an AuthKey from keymaster.beammp.com.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# BeamMP server (Octail's own install script): the official Linux build for Debian 12 from BeamMP's GitHub releases,
# its SHA-256 digest checked, failures exit non-zero. ServerConfig.toml is written only when there is none.
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
set -euo pipefail
apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y -qq curl jq ca-certificates > /dev/null

ASSET="BeamMP-Server.debian.12.x86_64"
VERSION="${VERSION:-latest}"
if [ "$VERSION" = "latest" ]; then
    API="https://api.github.com/repos/BeamMP/BeamMP-Server/releases/latest"
else
    API="https://api.github.com/repos/BeamMP/BeamMP-Server/releases/tags/${VERSION}"
fi
if ! RELEASE=$(curl -fsSL "$API"); then
    echo "Installation failed: BeamMP-Server release ${VERSION} wasn't found on GitHub."
    exit 1
fi
TAG=$(echo "$RELEASE" | jq -r '.tag_name')
URL=$(echo "$RELEASE" | jq -r --arg a "$ASSET" '.assets[] | select(.name == $a) | .browser_download_url')
DIGEST=$(echo "$RELEASE" | jq -r --arg a "$ASSET" '.assets[] | select(.name == $a) | .digest // empty')
if [ -z "$URL" ]; then
    echo "Installation failed: release ${TAG} has no ${ASSET}."
    exit 1
fi

echo "Installing BeamMP-Server ${TAG} from ${URL}"
cd /mnt/server
curl -fsSL -o BeamMP-Server.new "$URL"
if [ -n "$DIGEST" ]; then
    if ! echo "${DIGEST#sha256:}  BeamMP-Server.new" | sha256sum -c --quiet -; then
        rm -f BeamMP-Server.new
        echo "Installation failed: the download doesn't match its checksum."
        exit 1
    fi
else
    echo "GitHub lists no checksum for this release; not checked."
fi
chmod +x BeamMP-Server.new
mv -f BeamMP-Server.new BeamMP-Server

mkdir -p "Resources/Client" "Resources/Server"
if [ ! -f ServerConfig.toml ]; then
    echo "Writing a default ServerConfig.toml"
    cat > ServerConfig.toml <<'OCTAIL_EOF'
# This is the BeamMP-Server config file.
# Help & Documentation: `https://docs.beammp.com/server/server-maintenance/`
# IMPORTANT: Fill in the AuthKey with the key you got from `https://keymaster.beammp.com/` on the left under "Keys"

[General]
# AuthKey has to be filled out in order to run the server
AuthKey = ""
# Whether to allow guests
AllowGuests = true
Debug = false
Description = "BeamMP Default Description"
# Whether to allow unconnected clients to get the public server information without joining
InformationPacket = true
# The IP address to bind the server to, this is NOT related to your public IP. Can be used if your machine has multiple network interfaces
IP = "0.0.0.0"
# Whether to log chat messages in the console / log
LogChat = true
Map = "/levels/gridmap_v2/info.json"
MaxCars = 1
MaxPlayers = 8
Name = "BeamMP Server"
Port = 30814
Private = true
ResourceFolder = "Resources"
# Add custom identifying tags to your server to make it easier to find. Format should be TagA,TagB,TagC. Note the comma seperation.
Tags = "Freeroam"

[Misc]
# Hides the periodic update message which notifies you of a new server version. You should really keep this on and always update as soon as possible. For more information visit https://wiki.beammp.com/en/home/server-maintenance#updating-the-server. An update message will always appear at startup regardless.
ImScaredOfUpdates = false
# Specifies the time between update reminders. You can use any of "s, min, h, d" at the end to specify the units seconds, minutes, hours or days. So 30d or 0.5min will print the update message every 30 days or half a minute.
UpdateReminderTime = "30s"
OCTAIL_EOF
fi

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed: BeamMP-Server ${TAG}."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: AuthKey
variables.description: The server's key from https://keymaster.beammp.com (Keys). Required: BeamMP doesn't start without one. Each key runs one server at a time.

variables.name: Version
variables.description: latest, or a release tag such as v3.9.3. Applied on reinstall.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name in the server list (no double quotes or backslashes; ^ colour codes work).

variables.name: Description
variables.description: Shown in the server list (no double quotes or backslashes).

variables.name: Map
variables.description: The level, as /levels/<name>/info.json: gridmap_v2, west_coast_usa, east_coast_usa, italy, utah, jungle_rock_island, industrial, small_island, automation_test_track, hirochi_raceway, johnson_valley, derby, driver_training.

variables.name: Private
variables.description: true keeps the server out of the public server list (join by address); false lists it.
